scope: Controlled storefront with actual browser execution; no live Best Buy or original Cerebras-agent claim
timing: Browser preparation and prompt-to-verified-order wall time recorded separately; comparisons use complete wall time including preparation. Learning is separately recorded and included in aggregate workload cost.
determinism: Identical frozen state and inputs must yield identical product and semantic action sequence. Changed merchant state must be revalidated. An uncertain purchase must never be dispatched twice.
failurePolicy: Retain every attempt. Safe stops are not completions. Performance is ineligible if any required correctness or recovery case fails. Missing comparator or insufficient trials is inconclusive.
